#### What type of PR is this?
/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
If there are some pods that uses csi volume on the master node, when kube-apiserver restarts during the kubelet starting, the kubelet volumeManager may deadlock, and the kube-apiserver cannot start normally

> I don't like direction where is this going. Looking at #99188, it looks like kubelet wants to start a pod that needs a CSI volume. Since there is no API server at that point, I assume that it's a static pod. Question is why do you have a static pod that uses CSI volumes? It is not possible to start such a pod without CSIDriver caches synced, i.e. without connection to an API server.

Why are there are pods that use csi volume
Our k8s runs on bare metal server which , so k8s's pods and some other pods running on the same node.

Our upgrade sequence:
1. Upgrade kubelet
2. upgrade etcd, kube-apiserver, kube-scheduler, kube-controller-manager by modify the mainfest files, 

Why volumemanager is been locked？
After the kubelet is upgraded, the kube-apiserver is stopped during the kubelet starting, the kubelet is not fully started. The kubelet obtains the pods running on the current node from the old kube-apiserver, but the csiDriverInformers has not been synchronized. 
if a pod that use a csi volume is started before the kubelet starts the kube-apiserver, the volumeManager will be locked because the csiDriverInformers has not been synchronized, and then all pods on this node cannot start normally.

#### What happened:
kubelet's volumemanager locked when upgrade k8s cluster

Our Kubernetes cluster is installed on Bare Metal Server, and some pods on the nodes use CSI PVs,
Our k8s cluster upgrade processes is:

1. Upgrade Kubelet 
2. Stop etcd、haproxy、kube-apiserver、keepalived、kube-controller-manager、kube-scheduler by move the manifest files out of the monitoring directory of kubelet
3. Upgrade static pod of haproxy、keepalived and etcd 
4. Upgrade static pod of kube-apiserver、kube-controller and kube-scheduler

Problem: 
After the manifest file of kube-apiserver is placed in the monitoring directory of kubelet, the container of kube-apiserver is not created. 
kubelet will panic after a long time. I found that a deadlock occurred on kubelet in volumemanager.
